changelog: REPLAY: Archive playback now preserves the provider's original archive timestamp separately from the corrected guide clock.
REPLAY: Each provider URL now receives a complete LibVLC then Media3 pass before moving to the next time, duration, container, or legacy endpoint variant.
REPLAY: Added provider wall-clock, raw server timestamp, HLS/TS, small duration-padding, and legacy Xtream archive variants with a safe bounded retry limit.
REPLAY: The playback error screen now offers Retry Replay to restart the full provider-and-player recovery ladder.
